biotools.summary: Biophysical reaction-diffusion transport solver and research-only sanctuary dynamics CLI for compact EGFR-mutant NSCLC under osimertinib. Computes perivascular penetration and evolutionary sanctuary profiles; it is not a clinical decision system or treatment recommendation.
